summary: Environment A evidence for Bible Translation Registry v2 - fine-grained UsagePermissions on ContentMetadata/content_registry, with a real fail-closed enforcement point gating CIP's embedding pipeline on ai_processing_allowed.
trigger: User-supplied licensing-strategy research (YouVersion Platform vs. API.Bible vs. direct publisher licensing) with instruction to consider it and keep going. See docs/phase-9-audit.md.
gapFound: generate_verse_embeddings sent every verse of a translation's text into a local AI embedding model with zero licensing check - safe only by accident (BSB, the only translation ever embedded, happens to be public domain).
designChoice: UsagePermissions lives alongside LicensingStatus on ContentMetadata/content_registry (same home, different axis: admission vs. use-case permission). Every field defaults to None/unknown, never permissive. Only ai_processing_allowed is enforced this phase, fail-closed (opposite default from ensure_translation_selectable's fail-open, deliberately).
preExistingBugFixed: generate_verse_embeddings and get_embedding_capabilities both hardcoded the literal DEFAULT_TRANSLATION_ID ("KJV", a dev-fixture id never registered in a real production build) instead of resolve_default_translation_id - fixed as part of touching these exact call sites for the licensing gate.

newCode.coreContent: core/content/src/lib.rs: UsagePermissions (14 fields, 8 permits_* helpers), ContentMetadata.usage field.
newCode.integrationsContent: integrations/content/src/lib.rs: SqliteContentRegistry reads/writes every new column.
newCode.content_rs: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/content.rs: import_and_register threads dataset.translation.usage through to the registered ContentMetadata.
newCode.commands_rs: apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/commands.rs: ensure_ai_processing_permitted (pure, fail-closed), wired into generate_verse_embeddings; both that command and get_embedding_capabilities now resolve the real default translation.
newCode.bsbDataset: database/datasets/bsb/bsb.json + docs/data/bible/BSB/manifest.json: BSB's real usage permissions recorded as evidence (every flag true except training_allowed, left null).
newCode.roadmapDoc: docs/bible-translation-licensing-roadmap.md: the supplied research reframed as a named, actionable roadmap, cross-linked from docs/bible-translation-registry.md.

newTests.testingBoundaryNote: ensure_ai_processing_permitted is a pure function tested against a real in-memory SQLite registry (SqliteContentRegistry + cip_database::run_migrations), no tauri::test harness - the same split this codebase already uses for resolve_default_translation_id_from_registry.
newTests.command: cargo test --workspace && cargo test --features whisper (apps/desktop/src-tauri) && npm run test -- --run
newTests.result: 977 passed (workspace default), 320 passed (desktop, --features whisper), 266 passed (frontend) - 0 failures across all three

fullRegression.clippy: cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings: clean, both feature configs
fullRegression.frontend: npm run typecheck/lint/test/build: all clean - same 5 pre-existing lint warnings, no new ones

architecturalSafetyNotes: Zero new Tauri commands, zero new events - generate_verse_embeddings and get_embedding_capabilities are the only two existing command bodies changed.

core/bible and core/service (Bible detection) are entirely untouched - licensing lives only in ContentMetadata/content_registry, never in the detection or provider-serving path, per this phase's own explicit design choice.
Every prior ContentMetadata construction site (8 files, 11 literals) updated to populate the new field explicitly - reviewed individually, none silently defaulted.
Migration 0016 is purely additive (14 nullable ALTER TABLE ADD COLUMN statements) - no existing row's data changes shape or is rewritten.
honestLimitation: Only ai_processing_allowed is actually enforced; the other seven UsagePermissions fields are recorded and queryable but gate nothing yet, since no other call path in this codebase currently needs to restrict them. No operator-facing UI to view/edit UsagePermissions after import. No YouVersion/API.Bible network client code, no new Bible text, no Bible Society of Nigeria contact - see docs/bible-translation-licensing-roadmap.md's Phase B/C, both out of this session's reach (no real API keys or legal authority).
